examples.arabic: هي كانت معاها خمسين جنيه بس، يعني مش كفاية لكل القماش ده.
examples.english: She only had fifty pounds with her, meaning it wasn't enough for all this fabric.
examples.transliteration: Heyya kanet ma3aha khamsin gineih bas, ya3ny mish kefaya le koll el-oumash dah.

examples.arabic: منى كان معاها خمسين جنيه بس في شنطتها؛ يعني ده سعر كويس، بس هي كانت قلقانة.
examples.english: Mona only had fifty pounds in her bag; meaning, this was a good price, but she was worried.
examples.transliteration: Mona kan ma'aha khamseen geneh bas fi shantetha; ya'ni dah se'r kwayyes, bas heya kanet 'alqana.
examples.storyTitle: The Lost Book on El Moez Street

examples.arabic: سارة وصلت بعد ربع ساعة ومعاها خمسين جنيه.
examples.english: Sara arrived after fifteen minutes, with fifty pounds.
examples.transliteration: Sara waSalt ba'd rob' sa'a w ma'aha khamseen geneh.
examples.storyTitle: Mona's Lost Wallet at the Metro

examples.arabic: البياع ابتسم وقال خمسين جنيه هو سعر القهوة يا فندم
examples.english: The salesman smiled and said, "Fifty pounds is the price of the coffee, sir."
examples.transliteration: El-bayya' ebtasam w a'al khamsin geneh howa sa'r el-ahwa ya fandem.

examples.arabic: سيد كان معاه بس خمسين جنيه.
